title: Claim not abated by change.
bodyText: A claim for relief against a nonprofit association shall not abate merely because of a change in its members or persons authorized to manage the affairs of the nonprofit association.
bodyHtml: [§429-11]  Claim not abated by change.  A claim for relief against a nonprofit association shall not abate merely because of a change in its members or persons authorized to manage the affairs of the nonprofit association. [L 1999, c 161, pt of §1]
